name: Build weekly report from CSV + notes
prompt:
Read data/sales.csv and data/notes.txt.
Write out/report.md with:
# Weekly Report
## Total revenue
(a line with the integer total of all revenue values)
## Best day
(the day name with highest revenue)
## Note
(one sentence based on notes.txt — do not invent metrics)
Then write out/done.txt containing exactly: DONE
Stop when both files are correct.
